# GitHub Copilot — Instructions for This Repo

The canonical instructions for how to review code in this repo live in
**`AGENTS.md`** at the repository root. Read that file and follow it for
any code review, chat, or PR review request in this repo.

Quick summary, in case the full file isn't consulted:

- This is an **educational** project (a system design learning exercise),
  not production code. Calibrate feedback accordingly: always flag issues
  that undermine the concept a milestone is teaching; flag general good
  practice as secondary; only briefly note production-hardening that's
  intentionally out of scope.
- Review only the scope requested, not the whole repo, unless asked.
- Lead with what's done well, specifically — not just "looks good."
- When asked to fix something, make the fix directly rather than holding
  back the answer.
- At the end of a session, add succinct comments explaining *why* (design
  choices and improvements made), not what the code does.

See `AGENTS.md` for the full detail on review format and the end-of-session
summary file this repo expects.
